task: Put the tables from a PDF into an Excel workbook
packaging_note: Uses Camelot's lattice parser and PDFium locally; each table gets its own worksheet. Builds the tagged release from its checksum-pinned PyPI source distribution.

inputs.what: a PDF with selectable text and ruled tables; scans are not supported

outputs.what: one Excel worksheet per detected table, in page order

known_issues: Looks for tables with visible cell borders. A scan, borderless table or document with no table needs a different method.
